text: The following streets have a speed limit of 40 km/h: High Park Boulevard, Sunnyside Avenue, and Wright Avenue. Sections of these streets were never changed when the speed limit was reduced to 30 km/h in neighbourhoods in the Toronto East York Community Council catchment area. Reducing the speed limit from 40 km/h to 30 km/h would continue the treatment of residential streets that were changed in 2015 and 2016.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit on High Park Boulevard, between Parkside Drive and Roncesvalles Avenue, from 40 km/h to 30 km/h. 2. Reduced the speed limit on Sunnyside Avenue, between The Queensway and High Park Boulevard, from 40 km/h to 30 km/h. 3. Reduced the speed limit on Wright Avenue, between Parkside Drive and Roncesvalles Avenue, from 40 km/h to 30 km/h.
